I have analyzed the provided information and found several issues in the `dts/vendor/ti/j721e_main.dtsi` file. There are significant copy-paste errors in the `gpio-map` properties for several GPIO nexus nodes, leading to duplicate and incorrect pin mappings. These errors can confuse the build system's devicetree processing, which in turn can cause linker errors when a GPIO controller device is not correctly identified and included in the build.

Additionally, I've identified a minor issue in `tests/drivers/gpio/gpio_get_direction/CMakeLists.txt` where the project name was incorrect. While not the cause of the linker error, it is good practice to correct it.
